name: Inconsistent tax residency declarations
description: Customer self-certifies residence in one jurisdiction while mailing address, phone, spending or travel point to another.
fp: Expatriates and frequent travellers may have complex but genuine residency.

OECD, Model Mandatory Disclosure Rules for CRS Avoidance Arrangements and Opaque Offshore Structures (2018)
